[P2] Reconsider the separate terminal-hook path under rule 2

This constructs synthetic terminal state for an early `onOperationEnd`, then suppresses the existing checkpoint-completion path. Returning the step result early does not itself require moving the plugin notification before persistence: checkpoint completion could retain responsibility for that notification. Neither the description nor ADR-006 evaluates this simpler direction, although it avoids duplicated lifecycle logic and success notifications for unsaved results. Rule 2 requires considering simplification before adding these paths. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and evaluate retaining checkpoint-confirmed end hooks or explain why that cannot satisfy the requirement.
